200.description: Server-sent events; each `data` is an EventOut, `id` its seq.

AnsweredState.title: AnsweredState
AnsweredState.description: A proposal answers a field; it never returns one to "not asked".

cost_nano_usd.title: Cost Nano Usd
cost_nano_usd.description: 0 when no provider call was made (spend_state none); null: unknown.

requests_sent.title: Requests Sent
requests_sent.description: Provider requests in the attempt; a validation repair adds one.

Basis.title: Basis
Basis.description:
How an answer relates to what the person said (spec section 3: factual confirmations
and inferences are styled differently).

discovery_id.title: Discovery Id
discovery_id.description: The discovery that suggested it, if any.

ChooseTarget.title: ChooseTarget
ChooseTarget.description:
Make an ESCO occupation one of the targets: added, or in place of `replaces` (a
target title it is the occupation for).

ConnectionCheckResult.title: ConnectionCheckResult
ConnectionCheckResult.description:
What the model proposes for the synthetic persona. Structurally valid is not true.

Lengths are checked by a validator rather than schema keywords, so the JSON schema sent
to Meta stays within strict mode (Meta then enforces the structure itself).

ConversationMode.title: ConversationMode
ConversationMode.description: The tone the person chose (spec section 4, "Uncertainty and emotional comfort").

CredentialOut.title: CredentialOut
CredentialOut.description: Metadata only. No endpoint ever returns key material, or any part of it.

DataMode.title: DataMode
DataMode.description: Recorded on every workspace and run (Global Constraint 5, plan section 2).

DecideTurn.title: DecideTurn
DecideTurn.description:
Which proposals to apply. A hard-constraint field is applied only if it is also named
in `confirm_hard_constraints`; proposals not accepted are recorded as rejected.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the decision created; null when it changed nothing.

DecisionResult.title: DecisionResult
DecisionResult.description:
The decision and the resulting profile. The proposals are read from the turn: this
response is stored as the command's receipt, and model output is kept sealed.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version it read, pinned.

DiscoveryOut.title: DiscoveryOut
DiscoveryOut.description:
One discovery. `run` is authoritative for its state; `proposal` exists only once the
run is complete, and a failed run's failure class says why there is none.

origin.description: fixture: the deterministic demo proposer (synthetic), never a live model.

DiscoveryProposalOut.title: DiscoveryProposalOut
DiscoveryProposalOut.description: The validated searches. They name no suggestion: the slate is computed from them.

EntryMode.title: EntryMode
EntryMode.description: How the person chose to start (spec section 3, the You chapter).

ErrorStage.title: ErrorStage
ErrorStage.description: Which part of the product the failure affects.

EventOut.title: EventOut
EventOut.description: One status event. The stream's SSE `id` is `seq`; reconnect with Last-Event-ID.

EvidenceOut.title: EvidenceOut
EvidenceOut.description: One of the person's confirmed answers, quoted.

occupations.title: Occupations
occupations.description: Pooled occupations your excluded titles removed.

families.title: Families
families.description: Pooled occupations your excluded kinds of work removed.

title.title: Title
title.description: A search hypothesis until ESCO is found to hold it.

label.title: Label
label.description: null when a hidden (search-only) label matched.

Money.title: Money
Money.description: A payment, fee, cap or balance: never negative.

NotIncluded.title: NotIncluded
NotIncluded.description: Why a pooled occupation is not on the slate ("show why this wasn't included").

NotIncludedOut.title: NotIncludedOut
NotIncludedOut.description: A pooled occupation the slate does not show, and why.

text_rank.title: Text Rank
text_rank.description: PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd; orders this result only.

concept_id.title: Concept Id
concept_id.description: Nessa's internal concept ID (stable per URI).

regulated.title: Regulated
regulated.description: null: ESCO records no regulation note.

isco_groups.title: Isco Groups
isco_groups.description: ISCO-08 from the major group down to the unit group (the grouping pivot).

full_text_total.title: Full Text Total
full_text_total.description: null: full-text search did not run (the query has no searchable word but matched a label), which is not the same as no match.

OccupationSearchOut.title: OccupationSearchOut
OccupationSearchOut.description:
Exact label matches (all of them, when several occupations share a label), then
ranked full-text matches. `full_text_total` counts every other full-text match, so a
limited page is never mistaken for the whole result.

PartialCompleteness.title: PartialCompleteness
PartialCompleteness.description:
How complete a run's streamed reply is (spec section 18: partial results carry
completeness and freshness). Streamed text is never validated and never a result.

completeness.description: none: no text yet; streaming: the reply so far; stopped: this attempt's reply stopped, but the run goes on and may stream again or still be superseded (not final); incomplete: final, the run ended without a validated output; superseded: a validated output is stored, so read the proposal's reply once the run is complete.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Matches the run.partial_updated event that announced it.

text.title: Text
text.description: The reply so far; null when none or superseded.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the text was last written (freshness).

PartialReplyOut.title: PartialReplyOut
PartialReplyOut.description:
The turn's reply as it streams: unvalidated text, never a proposal. The turn's run
state and, once complete, its proposal are authoritative.

PlaceList.title: PlaceList
PlaceList.description:
The finite list of English cities a work area can name. A city is geography only:
it never implies residence or the right to work.

hits.title: Hits
hits.description: Occupations this query found (bounded per query).

PreferencesOut.title: PreferencesOut
PreferencesOut.description:
How the person chose to start and to be interviewed, and whether it is paused. Null:
not chosen yet (the interviewer then keeps to the practical mode).

ProfileDocument.title: ProfileDocument
ProfileDocument.description: A stored profile version's content: each field with the source that established it.

ProfileField.title: ProfileField
ProfileField.description: The only names a proposal may use: the profile's own fields.

enjoyed_tasks.description: Tasks the person enjoys (interest), at most 8.

confident_tasks.description: Tasks the person believes they can do (confidence), at most 8.

evidenced_tasks.description: Tasks the person has evidence they can do, at most 8.

work_style.description: How the person says they like to work (optional), at most 8: it informs suggestions and never excludes any kind of work.

minimum_salary.description: The lowest gross pay the person will accept, with its period: a hard limit, set only by their confirmation. Recorded, not yet applied: no suggestion is removed for pay until pay evidence exists, and unknown pay is never below it.

ProfileInput.title: ProfileInput
ProfileInput.description: What a client submits: states and values only.

version.title: Version
version.description: 0 means nothing has been saved yet.

origin.description: fixture: the deterministic demo interviewer (synthetic), never a live model.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the proposals were made for.

ProposalOut.title: ProposalOut
ProposalOut.description: A complete, validated interview output. Nothing in it is saved until decided.

value.title: Value
value.description: The proposed answer, typed as the field's input; null unless provided. A list is the complete list after the change: accepting it replaces the field's list.

basis.description: stated: the value appears in the cited messages (checked by the server); inferred: implied, or not found in them.

message_ids.title: Message Ids
message_ids.description: The person's messages it rests on.

hard_constraint.title: Hard Constraint
hard_constraint.description: A limit or target: applied only if named in confirm_hard_constraints.

concept_kind.title: Concept Kind
concept_kind.description: provisional: Nessa's own concept for a verified title, never an ESCO one.

ProvisionalConceptOut.title: ProvisionalConceptOut
ProvisionalConceptOut.description: A title the person verified that ESCO does not hold: no ESCO URI, no ISCO group.

QueryChannel.title: QueryChannel
QueryChannel.description:
The model's discovery channels (spec section 4, DIV-1's five channels). Nessa adds
the person's current role and their own target titles itself.

ReleaseRefOut.title: ReleaseRefOut
ReleaseRefOut.description: The ESCO release the slate searched; show the attribution and adaptation with it.

output.description: A connection check's result. An interview turn's proposals are read through the turn (`GET .../interview/turns/{turn_id}`).

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the run read, pinned at submission.

RunOut.title: RunOut
RunOut.description: The authoritative run state. A failed or unavailable run never carries an output.

period.description: Annual unless the person says otherwise.

SalaryFloor.title: SalaryFloor
SalaryFloor.description:
The lowest gross pay the person will accept, as they gave it: its period is kept and
never converted, because annualising needs working hours (spec section 5).

SetPreferences.title: SetPreferences
SetPreferences.description: The whole set of preferences; null means not chosen.

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: 0 while the defaults have never been saved.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The minimum inputs: a target and four practical answers.

SketchOut.title: SketchOut
SketchOut.description:
The early requirement sketch: never a feasible or optimal route, never priced or
dated. Every step stays unresolved until a later chapter resolves it.

SlateChannel.title: SlateChannel
SlateChannel.description: How a candidate was found: the model's channels plus Nessa's own.

family_limit.title: Family Limit
family_limit.description: At most this many from one kind of work.

fewer_reasons.title: Fewer Reasons
fewer_reasons.description: Why there are fewer than six, if there are.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: How a control changed the slate, in words.

limits_not_applied.title: Limits Not Applied
limits_not_applied.description: Limits you set that the slate records but cannot apply yet.

beyond_pool_limit.title: Beyond Pool Limit
beyond_pool_limit.description: Occupations found past the pool's bound.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Every search that ran, with its hits.

unsupported_hypotheses.title: Unsupported Hypotheses
unsupported_hypotheses.description: Titles Nessa thought of that ESCO does not list: never suggested.

SlateOut.title: SlateOut
SlateOut.description:
A varied slate of up to six career hypotheses from the discovery's searches, computed
deterministically each time it is read, with every count that explains it.

discovery_id.title: Discovery Id
discovery_id.description: An occupation choice: the discovery that suggested it.

SourceOut.title: SourceOut
SourceOut.description:
Where an answer came from. A conversation source also names the turn that proposed
it, the person's messages it cites and its basis; `recorded_by` confirmed it.

period_committed_nano_usd.title: Period Committed Nano Usd
period_committed_nano_usd.description: Known costs plus the full reservation of every call whose cost is unknown.

SpendOut.title: SpendOut
SpendOut.description: Provider spend in integer nano-USD (Meta bills in USD; never a float).

SubmitRun.title: SubmitRun
SubmitRun.description:
`POST /runs` starts the runs that need no input; interview turns have their own
endpoint, which records the person's message with the run.

send_after_support.title: Send After Support
send_after_support.description: The person was shown the support response for this message and chose to send it to the interviewer anyway.

family.description: The kind of work: its ISCO-08 minor group.

matched_queries.title: Matched Queries
matched_queries.description: The query IDs that found it.

workday.title: Workday
workday.description: ESCO's description of the work, shortened.

try_it.title: Try It
try_it.description: Low-cost ways to test the idea before committing.

SuggestionOut.title: SuggestionOut
SuggestionOut.description:
A career hypothesis (spec section 4's `CareerSuggestion`): an ESCO occupation, the
answers that found it and ESCO's facts about it, in words. Becoming a target needs the
person's choice (`POST .../targets`).

checked_on.title: Checked On
checked_on.description: When the service's own page was last checked.

review_status.title: Review Status
review_status.description: The policy is provisional until reviewed.

SupportResponseOut.title: SupportResponseOut
SupportResponseOut.description:
Given instead of a turn when a message explicitly expresses acute distress: the
message was not sent to the interviewer and nothing was stored. Kept apart from career
suitability. Resend with `send_after_support` to send the message anyway.

occupations.title: Occupations
occupations.description: The ESCO occupation, or the several that share the title (choose one).

close_matches.title: Close Matches
close_matches.description: For a title ESCO does not hold: the nearest occupations by full text.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: ESCO's essential skills, the first few.

adaptation.title: Adaptation
adaptation.description: How this import adapts the release: it is marked so.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: A reduced test copy: never the catalogue a person sees.

repeated_rows_collapsed.title: Repeated Rows Collapsed
repeated_rows_collapsed.description: Concept rows the release repeats with only their modified date changed, imported once (part of the transformation).

TaxonomyReleaseOut.title: TaxonomyReleaseOut
TaxonomyReleaseOut.description:
The import manifest of the ESCO release in use (TAX1-04). Show `attribution` and
`adaptation` wherever ESCO content appears (ESCO's two reuse conditions).

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The profile version the message was sent with.

TurnOut.title: TurnOut
TurnOut.description:
One interview turn. `run` is authoritative for its state: `proposal` exists only when
the run is complete, and a failed run's failure class says why there is none.

WorkState.title: WorkState
WorkState.description: One state vocabulary (spec section 3, STATE-01). A failure is never an empty success.

fixture.title: Fixture
fixture.description: The named fixture workspace that `make reset-demo` resets.

last_event_seq.title: Last Event Seq
last_event_seq.description: The workspace's latest status-event sequence number when read: pass it as Last-Event-ID to receive only what happens after this read.

HTTPBearer.description: A Firebase ID token from the Auth emulator.
